findings.title: Celebrating completion fires a toast while the CelebrationOverlay dialog is open (breaks AC-6.6)
findings.where: §8 Complete task + Major milestone rows; §3.5 Toasts; §14.3; AC-6.5, AC-6.6
findings.fix: In completeTask compute celebrationFor(...) first; if non-null, skip notify() (overlay carries the message). In useRegisterOpenDialog call sonner toast.dismiss() when the open-dialog count goes 0→1. Reword AC-6.6 to cover toasts created just before a dialog opened; add an audit case (complete task 1 then 4 → overlay open, 0 [data-sonner-toast]). Change §8 to 'Toast only when celebrationFor returns null.'

findings.title: 'HANUMAN mission' has three conflicting predicates (longRunning / category / kind)
findings.where: §11 IA-7 todaysMission; §8 celebration trigger (a) and copy variants; §9.1 family picker and Feed summary; §3.5 TaskCard HANUMAN variant; §12 F13
findings.fix: Add `export const isHanumanMission = (t: Task) => t.longRunning === true;` and use it for todaysMission exclusion, celebrationFor trigger (a) (drop category === 'HANUMAN'), the TaskCard HANUMAN variant, and the §8 copy-variant comments. FamilyBadge keeps category, sourceLabel keeps kind. In §9.1 replace 'sets only category' with 'writes category with today's side effects verbatim: Squirrel/Angad clear contributors and keep only the owner note; HANUMAN also sets longRunning: true and kind: "HANUMAN"'. Test: a category-HANUMAN task without longRunning is in todaysMission, never triggers 'hanuman', and has non-null journey.

findings.title: Jambavan's Reflection observation and its 'Review deadline watch' button are unspecified
findings.fix: Add the pure reflectionFor(depts, tasks): string[] in selectors.ts (tie-break by name, zero case 'Nothing is overdue or blocked.', singular/plural, 'sits with {dept}' only when all stuck tasks share one department, else 'across {n} departments'); drop 'this week' (department values are static seed). Seed output: 'Operations is 31 points behind Marketing.' / '1 mission is overdue and blocked, and it sits with Operations.' / 'A short check-in with its Task Owner may unblock it.' The button scrolls to and focuses the existing Dashboard 'Deadline watch' card heading (Home.tsx:1012), secondary variant. Add unit tests and AC-12.3 (seed lines; after task 6 is completed or archived, 'Nothing is overdue or blocked.').

findings.title: Lede '2 missions need you today' sits next to '1 due today' (task 4 is due 30 Sep)
findings.fix: Reword to '{n} active missions are on your path today.' / '1 active mission is on your path today.', or explicitly accept the current wording.

findings.fix: mergeTaskEdit(existing, draft, ctx: { departmentOf: (name) => string | undefined; nextId: () => number }); the store passes a profiles lookup and Date.now()+Math.random(); tests pass stubs.
